Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Pavan Kumar Nath, Advocate for
the petitioner.
Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel
for the State.
Heard.
It is the case of the petitioner that in
the District Rudraprayag, election for
Primary Teachers Association,
Rudraprayag, is bad because many
persons, who cast their votes were not
elected delegates.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the election of Primary
Teachers Association, Rudraprayag, which
was conducted on 24.03.2025, is bad
because many persons, who voted in it,
were not elected delegates; the petitioner
has made representations on 03.04.2025
and 17.06.2025 to the Sub-Registrar,
Firms, Societies and Chits, Dehradun, but
no action has been taken on it. He seeks
directions that the respondents may be
directed to take action on it.
Learned State Counsel submits that
the representations dated 03.04.2025 and
17.06.2025, will be decided by the
respondents within a period of four weeks.
The Court takes on record the
statement given by learned State Counsel.
The writ petition is disposed of with
the direction to the respondent no.1/Sub-Registrar, Firms, Societies and Chits,
Dehradun, to decide the representations

dated 03.04.205 and 17.06.2025, within a
period of four weeks from today, in
accordance with law.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)
 06.08.2025
